reviews.comment: I found it hard to enjoy this class because she used her personal opinions to teach us. She gave me really bad grades on discussion posts. (Literally supposed to be my POV and she claimed my arguments were incorrect). She didn't seem to care for students.

I will say, I dropped this course due to the TA. As a professor, she was very good. Though I would get lost very quickly in her lectures. Group projects were weekly, and my group made me do everything. Exams were graded by the TA, and she was AWFUL with technology, and it caused me to fail 2 exams. After complaining to prof, she didn't help at all.

She had extremely biased opinions on the topics in the class...and one time she grabbed a water bottle and said "This could be called a water bottle, or it could be called a phone!" It was very relativistic. Needless to say, I would not take it again. For the class, she required group discussion but not many people talked, and the exams were essays

CL was very present in class and provided valuable information. Exams were not given, but quizzes and two strong papers accounted for most of the grade. Ask what she wants! There is also a project that can be done with a partner. Attendance is taken off and will affect your grade. If you plan to miss class ever, this is NOT the class for you.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly a pretty lenient prof, but never in all my years of living have I met someone less responsive to emails. In grading essays she can harsh if you don't say exactly what she is looking for, and a part of me thinks she taught this class because she wanted to her herself talk. All that said, she's chill. Participate and you'll be fine.

I had really big family issues during the semester (a university excusal letter was even sent to all my professors from the university itself) and she showed no lee way in working with me on paper due dates besides what was required by the university. She has also asked for my OPINION in class before and when I spoke I was told my OPINION was wrong
Difficult test. Make sure to read weekly to understand somewhat of the test.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the grading criteria an be a little unclear at times. most of the lecture is spent discussing the readings, which really helps you prepare for the exam, so even though attendance is not mandatory, it can be helpful.

Shes not very good at communicating via email and doesnt really seem to care about the students and is more invested in research, which is fine but might as well take academic leave. Other than that the material is awful given its just feminist propaganda meant to spark more hate and division as if we dont have enough in this country already.

Best prof I have ever had. She is opinionated but every single thing she presents in class is backed up by multiple research sources. Her lectures were so interesting & I actually enjoyed the readings. You should be fine just reading the abstract & conclusion to be able to participate in class discussions. Tests were multiple choice & free response
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: My least favorite professor so far. Very liberal points of views and does not consider any other options valid. Her lectures are not backed up with accurate sources, just anything that will tell her what she wants to hear. Not a hard class, but she definitely had her own separate agenda to put upon us. Would not recommend taking.

Doesnt care about students at all, more invested in research. Also doesnt reply to emails, and if she does its when its too late in the semester. Somebody please report her to the head of the department!!

The worst professor Ive ever had. Doesnt care at all if students are failing or struggling in general and is so apathetic. Puts on a fake nice attitude during class but is really demeaning and condescending. Also doesnt respond to emails unless she feels like it basically. Super unprofessional

Amazing professor. This is my second time taking one of her classes and I would again if I was able to. The lectures and readings are very interesting. She presents a ppt and then the class has a discussion. 2 exams and one paper that could be done with a partner. Other grades come from weekly chat posts and participation. Highly recommend!!!

Lucky that the subject is very easy to grasp because the class was not well organized, and she hardly ever even spoke. Semester long project presentations acted as lectures. The class felt like a church session. She would let students vent about their families, daily, allowing a lot of profanity. Subject matter is admittedly profane, though.

Prof. Lakkimsetti is a really good prof, especially if this is a topic that interests you. If you read and show up to class you should be fine. Her lectures are over the reading and include class discussion. Most of the people that complain about their grade are the ones that don't go to class.

I had a great time in this class. I was nervous when reading some reviews but Lakimsetti is a great professor. If there's ever a disconnect, she's willing to help students. This class is probably difficult if you don't have an actual interest in the subject though. Read the articles she posts and study the lecture slides and you're good.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: An amazing professor. You will read a bit, but if you know basic sociology, it will help a lot. Do not be afraid to speak up, she loves when students have feedback. Read at least the synopsis and findings when it comes to the journals she assigns.

Dr. Lakkimsetti's intro WGST class was really interesting and educating. It's a great choice to take rather than sociology in my opinion. There are lots of readings but they're interesting. The only difficult part about the class was the two exams but they were online and I still got a decent grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Lakkimsetti was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about her work. The readings throughout the semester were fascinating and the class consisted of student presentations on each reading, followed by discussion questions, and professor lecture. Absolutely loved this class!

This class honestly wasn't that hard. There are readings to do each week and discussion questions, but you can answer them without reading. The class is a hybrid, so when you do have to go to class, it's really boring and nothing of importance is really said. The prof herself is really passionate, which is good but she has high expectations.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Class is easy as long as you either do the readings or show up to class, she likes class participation and is willing to awkwardly wait in silence till someone says something.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Although she has assigned readings before every class, I usually would just read the abstract/conclusion so I could participate in the discussion (which you get points for) She is super passionate about the subject and the students, and I really enjoyed her class. Its literally just discussion, 2 essays and 2 tests which she provides guides for

She is very opinionated and lets you know when she doesn't agree with you. The class is not an easy A but if you browse the readings and the powerpoints the night before you should be fine. You will basically get a 100 on everything except the tests so that helps because there are only 5-6 grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class is interesting but I don't recommend it. It's not an easy course and you're expected to read over 30 different readings and that's all you're tested on. The class is very biased and if you disagree you won't get a good grade. 2 Tests, 2 Essays, and Attendance is mandatory. I lucked out with my A.

If you have the chance, take anyone but her. She has such a biased opinion and if you dont agree with her, good luck getting a good grade. She doesnt make requirements clear and overall shes honestly just rude.

Tests are very easy if you study hard and do the readings. Sometimes I was very surprised by my grade because I studied really hard and didn't get the grade I wished for. If you do the readings and take notes during class then you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is really passionate and knowledgeable about the topic. There was a lot of reading but it was very interesting. You pretty much have to read to pass the tests although the powerpoints are very thorough. She encourages a lot of participation and class discussion and classmates talking to each other rather than just to her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: A LOT of reading. If you don't do it, most of what you need to know is in her PowerPoints, but the one short paper and the short answers on tests are easier if you've done the readings. She likes the class to be an open environment so sometimes it gets off topic and can be boring. Attendance is factored into your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Class is discussion based so you HAVE to do the readings assigned before each class because she goes around the room to ask everyone's opinion of the reading. Readings are normally between 25-35 pages so be ready to read! Two big papers are 45% of your grade, but she is a pretty easy grader. Very interesting course. It will change your perspective!
Sometimes she's a bit difficult to understand. Her tests are easy as long as you do the readings! They are COMPLETELY taken from them.

This class wasn't an easy A but you get what you put in. She uses 100% of the textbook, 2 readings before every class. The class itself discussion based and she really appreciates participation. She gets monotone sometimes, but peers' input makes the class interesting and controversial. Majority of the test Q's are straight from online e-book.

This class is very reading intensive. Her exams test how well you can remember each reading. Most of her lectures comprise of summaries of the reading and class discussions. She assigned a group project at the end of the semester that was not listed in the syllabus. As long as you read you should be able to succeed in the class.
